headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 18, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with José Ramírez leading the charge at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBI.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Jordan Beck, left fielder for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Additionally, Eric Lauer, now with the Los Angeles Dodgers, has been traded from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. Other injured players include Ben Casparius of the Los Angeles Dodgers, Corey Seager of the Texas Rangers, Kyle Farmer of the Atlanta Braves, Jose Altuve of the Houston Astros, Cole Sulser of the Tampa Bay Rays, Kris Bubic of the Kansas City Royals, and A.J. Minter of the New York Mets.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have made a notable roster move, acquiring Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for cash. Other trades and roster movements include Junior Perez being traded from the Athletics to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove, Kyle Robinson being traded from the Athletics to the Pittsburgh Pirates for 2B Alika Williams, and Eduarniel Núñez being traded from the Athletics to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Cruise Past Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with José Ramírez leading the charge at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run (8) on a fly ball to left field and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves, securing a 12-0 victory. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Jordan Beck on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Jordan Beck has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers**
top_news.summary: Eric Lauer has been traded to the Los Angeles Dodgers. The left-handed pitcher was acquired by the Dodgers in exchange for cash.
